scope: Synthetic Northstar source-contract checks only; not deployed model, engine or live authority.

population.compatibility: Require known complete provenance before joins or cohort transfers, including cached and empty artifacts. Compare profile, seed, generator revision, identity contract and the complete shared-map commitment independently of source clocks. Reused keys, aliases and equal timestamps are not evidence.
population.binding: Live binding_hash is SHA-256 of the existing canonical digest of {workspace_id,dataset_id}, resolved and reviewed privately against NativeSnapshot.sources. Never store actual identifiers here. Local bindings hash the actual fixture folder and source alias; they cannot authorize live execution.
population.localExtraction: Catalog.fixture_population validates actual files against the current fixture manifest, retains its canonical digest and per-table logical hashes, and hashes the known structural identity schema. Shared commitments include core dimensions except quarantine, subscriptions, contracts and explicit *_map tables. No evaluator or generator implementation is read.
population.localGeneratorRevision: Existing fixture manifest version identifies the declared structural generator format only. It is NOT a generator-code commit or deployed source inventory revision. Implementation-revision evidence is absent from historical fixture manifests and remains a live-capture blocker.
population.migration: Artifact.source_populations defaults to [] only for legacy construction and isolated single-source reads. UNKNOWN cannot join or transfer. Executor accepts reviewed source_populations explicitly, or the same optional provider attribute for local test adapters; non-fixture adapters must also attach that provenance to returned artifacts, including cache hits. Preflight metadata cannot relabel unknown cached output. Only an actual OfflineProvider in OFFLINE_SYNTHETIC derives fixture provenance.
population.liveGate: No live population capture or adapter/configuration wiring is asserted. Live metadata must be captured and reviewed, validated against the exact private native source bindings, then supplied to Executor. Missing metadata blocks cross-source execution; no synthetic fallback.

metricAuthority: Existing native proxy/source-model/home-table/measure and query-use checks remain authoritative before execution. Names, aliases or this scenario inventory do not grant native authority. Source formulas, units, aggregation, date roles and allowed home-table dimensions are unchanged.
dateDecisions: Business effective intervals use half-open UTC [start,end) overlap and clipped intersections; they are separate from all four freshness clocks.

Remove Calendar start-month relationships from Contracts and Service Site Map in the local template and generator. No unused inactive relationship or replacement contract fact relationship is inferred.
An explicitly requested start-month analysis may select date_role month; it is not an effective-period cohort. Interval-role queries reject accidental month predicates.

Project reviewed contract/account/site identities explicitly; filter contract_key directly on each metric's actual home table using existing TREATAS compilation. Do not rely on a missing Contracts-to-SLA Evaluation source relationship.
Serving-site market selects network membership, not Finance home market. Service month, incident start month, contract/map start month and posting time are distinct roles.
grainAndCompleteness: Deduplicate the selected contract cohort before source contract-month settlement, then account identities before source Finance account-month queries.
Incident selection changes membership only; no incident-attributed credit or Finance credit allocation arithmetic.
Source-owned nonadditive values must be queried at final context; cohort overflow blocks instead of summing or averaging batches.
Missing, unknown, denied and partial output never becomes zero or a complete total. Empty known cohorts skip the destination and do not observe a destination clock or total.

clocks.data: Per-source data state and applicable table evidence.
clocks.ontology: Native metadata revision; not the source-model compatibility level.
clocks.context: Acquired context/cache revision and current authorization.
clocks.comparison: Keep existing separate validation. Compatible unrelated sources may have unequal valid refresh timestamps. Equal clocks cannot repair mixed populations.
